beats.headline: Picked up on the road
beats.text: On the way south toward the swamp where Samantha and the boss spider wait, Carl and Donut grind through mobs, most of them talking birds, none of them worth a flag. Among the cards they collect is one more snare card, called Hole in the Bag, which drains a totem's mana. Unlike their Hobble card, this one is not consumable. They also find a rare mystic card called Force Discard.

beats.headline: One of three snares
beats.text: In the first eighteen-card deck Carl and Donut build for practice, Hole in the Bag is one of three snare cards, beside the consumable Hobble and the new Damnation. None of them can do anything in the simulation, since snares only work against card-carrying opponents. Carl wants them in anyway, and suspects snares may be worth more than utility cards, of which the deck has six.
